_spec: BANZA Core Capability Satisfaction — Conformance Vectors
_boundary: These vectors decide whether a DECLARATION satisfies a REQUIREMENT. They say nothing about whether the declaration is true: that is established by conformance evidence, never by declaring.

vectors.title: a canonical identifier satisfies the requirement
a canonical identifier among others still satisfies
a required capability that is absent is not satisfied
an unrelated capability does not satisfy
an unregistered string does not satisfy a core requirement
vectors.rule: spec/capabilities.md §2 — the member accepts other strings; they satisfy nothing

vectors.title: a registered alias satisfies the capability it aliases
vectors.rule: spec/capabilities.md §4 — accepted on input; canonical emission remains inter_operator_settlement

vectors.title: a separator variant is not the identifier
vectors.rule: §3 — no separator substitution, in either direction

vectors.title: a case variant is not the identifier
a plural is not the identifier
a prefix of an identifier is not the identifier
a supports_* flag name declared as a capability string satisfies nothing
vectors.rule: §5 — supports_traces is NARROWER than traceability; and a flag NAME used as a capability string is not a core identifier in any case
